lines.text: What happens if you don't sleep for seven days?
After twenty four hours, your brain is flooded with adenosine, making you as impaired as being legally drunk.
By day two, your body experiences micro sleeps, shutting you off for seconds without you even knowing.
On day three, you lose grip on reality, hallucinating eerie shadows and hearing voices.
By day four, severe paranoia sets in as stress hormones spike out of control.
On day five, your speech slurs and your motor skills fail as your brain misfires.
By day seven, your organs begin shutting down, and total collapse can be fatal.
Which is why sleep is not optional, it is pure survival.
